# docker_image_attestations (Data Source)

Reads the in-toto attestations (SBOM, provenance) stored with a local image (`GET /images/{name}/attestations`, Engine API 1.55+). The image must be in the containerd image store with its attestation manifests, e.g. pulled from a registry or built with `provenance` / `sbom`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# SBOM and provenance attestations stored with a local image
# (Engine API 1.55+, containerd image store).
data "docker_image_attestations" "app" {
  name              = "ghcr.io/example/app:1.0"
  predicate_types   = ["https://spdx.dev/Document"]
  include_statement = true
}

output "sbom_digests" {
  value = data.docker_image_attestations.app.digests
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Image name, tag or ID, e.g. `ghcr.io/org/app:1.0`.

### Optional

- `include_statement` (Boolean) Include each in-toto statement itself (`attestations[*].statement`, JSON). Default `false`: descriptors and predicate types only.
- `platform` (String) Platform of a multi-platform image to read, `os[/arch[/variant]]`. Default: the daemon's platform. Needs API 1.55+ (containerd image store).
- `predicate_types` (List of String) Only attestations with one of these in-toto predicate types, e.g. `https://spdx.dev/Document` or `https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1`.

### Read-Only

- `attestations` (Attributes List) The GET /images/{name}/attestations response as a nested object, field by field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attestations))
- `attestations_json` (String, Sensitive) The Engine API GET /images/{name}/attestations response as JSON; entries in the Engine's order. Re-encoded, not byte-exact: the moby client keeps no raw body for this call, so this is the decoded response written as canonical JSON (keys sorted, compact).
- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of attestations_json.
- `digests` (List of String) Digests of the attestation manifests (`Descriptor.digest`), in response order.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).
- `image_ref` (String) The image reference whose attestations were read (`name`, normalized when it is a tag).

<a id="nestedatt--attestations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attestations`

Read-Only:

- `descriptor` (Attributes) Upstream `Descriptor`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attestations--descriptor))
- `predicate_type` (String) Upstream `PredicateType`.
- `statement` (String, Sensitive) Upstream `Statement`. Sensitive. Canonical JSON (keys sorted, snake_case): no nested fields are fixed here and Terraform allows no dynamic value inside a list, set or map.

<a id="nestedatt--attestations--descriptor"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attestations.descriptor`

Read-Only:

- `annotations` (Map of String) Upstream `annotations`.
- `artifact_type` (String) Upstream `artifactType`.
- `data` (String, Sensitive) Upstream `data`. Sensitive.
- `digest` (String) Upstream `digest`.
- `media_type` (String) Upstream `mediaType`.
- `platform` (String) Upstream `platform`. Canonical JSON (keys sorted, snake_case): no nested fields are fixed here and Terraform allows no dynamic value inside a list, set or map.
- `size` (Number) Upstream `size`.
- `urls` (List of String) Upstream `urls`.
